title: A Rivergate for the Escarpment
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Kavanagh, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
